entities.summary: Mykhailo Serhiyovych Hrechukha was a Ukrainian and Soviet politician, who served as the Chairman of Presidium of the Supreme Council of the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic from 1939 to 1954. He was elected to the 1st through 5th convocations of Verkhovna Rada of the Ukrainian SSR.
